title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.99
summary: Live-Ton nutzt den synchronisierten A/V-Broker der Aufnahmen; AAC-Erkennung in HLS-Segmenten repariert.
changes: Reuse the combined H264/AAC go2rtc broker used by recordings for opt-in live audio
Use a single synchronized MPEG-TS input rather than independent TS video and ADTS audio inputs for the browser audio player
Accept duplicate AAC codec lines from FFprobe when checking HLS MPEG-TS segments
Log LOCAL_HLS_AUDIO_VERIFIED only when a completed HLS segment really contains AAC
Add live/recording sharing assertions and optionally test against a real FFmpeg-generated MPEG-TS sample
Preserve the visible live player, existing recording pipeline, camera data, and private PHP 3.1.1
Add independent CI checks for live HLS AAC, recording broker reuse and frontend single-player behavior
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.99
description: Repair opt-in live audio by sharing the proven recording A/V producer and correctly verifying AAC
releaseNotes: Upgrade camera server to 2.20.99. Live sound now follows the same H264/AAC broker as recordings while the visible video remains untouched. To test: request audio, wait for LOCAL_HLS_AUDIO_VERIFIED or 'Audiokanal bereit', then tap to unmute. If the camera still reports no audio, check FFmpeg/HLS diagnostics; production verification is required.
